origins: arXiv:2605.24660 (How Many Tools Should an LLM Agent See? A Chance-Corrected Answer), 2026-06-07, RL-agent tool-shortlist depth study on BFCL
arXiv:2505.10570 (LongFuncEval: long context models for function calling), 2025-05-15, long-context degradation benchmark for function calling
reason: Two distinct arXiv preprints with different identifiers, roughly thirteen months apart, different titles, and different measurements. s1 studies the optimal shortlist length K for tool retrieval using a chance-corrected metric and an RL agent evaluated on BFCL; s2 (LongFuncEval) measures performance degradation as tool-catalog size and response length grow in long-context function calling. Different research efforts asking different questions, not the same study re-surfaced. A shared arxiv.org host does not make them one origin.
